speaker: Doctor
text: I need to understand the timing of your symptoms; do your double vision and weakness worsen when you look upward or after physical exertion like climbing stairs? Also, have you noticed any drooping eyelids or difficulty swallowing recently?

speaker: Patient
text: The double vision usually happens when I look up or down, and the weakness in my arms and legs gets worse after activity but improves if I rest. I have not noticed balance problems or numbness.

speaker: Doctor
text: REQUEST TEST: Serum AChR antibodies and Anti-MuSK antibodies. Also, please perform the Ice Pack Test on your eyelids and describe the results.
